query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 719 AND 723), 'topics', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics WHERE slug IN ('second-world-war-sensitive-boundary-719','second-world-war-start-date-boundary-720','second-world-war-end-date-boundary-721','united-nations-origin-boundary-722','united-nations-diplomacy-boundary-723')), 'facts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 719 AND 723 AND title IN ('Second World War — start date','Second World War — formal end date','United Nations — official beginning')), 'mcqs', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE (source_page, source_question_number) IN ((720,'3'),(721,'14'))), 'mcq_options', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE (m.source_page, m.source_question_number) IN ((720,'3'),(721,'14'))), 'verifications', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 719 AND 723 AND verification_status='verified'), 'flashcards', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0719-0723:%'), 'search_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 719 AND 723 AND title IN ('Second World War — start date','Second World War — formal end date','United Nations — official beginning'))) OR (d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE (source_page, source_question_number) IN ((720,'3'),(721,'14')))))) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
